facts.fact: The Council of Ministers of 2 July 2025 authorised four 2025 digital procurements of the Ministry of Digital Transition (cybersecurity equipment 95 million, supervision centres 4 billion, their works supervision 200 million, RESINA equipment 1.6 billion), totalling 5,895,000,000 F CFA TTC, and states the financing is assured by the State budget.
